sectionRhythm.summary: Vertical padding between sections: compact = tighter, generous = roomier.

cards.summary: Card surfaces: flat = tinted fill no shadow, outlined = stronger hairline no shadow, elevated = deeper shadow.

buttons.summary: Button shape: pill = fully rounded, sharp = square corners, bold = uppercase tracked labels.

heroScale.summary: Hero headline size: compact = smaller, dramatic = larger display type.

imageTreatment.summary: Framed images: natural = no brand grade, mono = greyscale, rounded = larger corner radius.

nav.summary: Top navigation: bordered = hairline under the bar, inverted = primary-colour bar with light text.

footer.summary: Footer surface: light = muted light surface, brand = primary colour.

accentUsage.summary: The italic accent word in headlines: subtle = headline colour, plain = no accent styling, underline = action-colour underline.
